name: _Table Header
description: Private semantic header renderer for the Table's four fixed column meanings. It owns header geometry and native column-header semantics but is never a public composition primitive.

props.name: primaryLabel
props.description: Primary column label supplied by Table.

props.name: secondaryLabel
props.description: Secondary column label supplied by Table.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Status column label supplied by Table.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Action column label supplied by Table.

anatomy.name: column-headers
anatomy.description: Exactly four th scope=col cells in Primary / Secondary / Status / Action order.

semantics.element: native thead containing one tr with four th scope=col column headers
semantics.accessibleName: Each non-empty visible label names its corresponding column.
semantics.keyboardActivation: none; header cells are not interactive
semantics.focus: The private header does not create focusable elements.
requirements: Exactly four native column headers are rendered in Primary / Secondary / Status / Action order.
Changing label copy never adds, removes, reorders, sorts, or changes a column's semantic role.
Primary flexes while Secondary / Status / Action match the row's reviewed 100px / 160px / 128px content widths.
The reviewed header is 44px tall with 20px inline insets and shared 24px / 24px / 8px inter-region gaps.
No sort state, icon, select-all control, arbitrary Header Cell API, or data-grid toolbar behavior exists.
The helper remains private and must not appear in the public React barrel or package exports.

content.description: Fixed private semantic header anatomy only.
